name: forge-agent
description: Agentic coding assistant for VS Code. The agent loop runs on TrueForge; the editor is exposed to it as MCP tools.
author: Git Push

forge.agentName.description: Primary TrueForge agent used by the panel.

forge.fallbackAgentName.description: Agent used when the primary fails (different model/provider).

forge.fallbackModel.description: Configurable model identifier for the fallback provider.

forge.fallbackModels.description: Ordered list of fallback models to try when the primary model fails or is overloaded.

forge.firstTokenTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds waiting for the first token before cancelling and failing over.

forge.stallTimeoutMs.description: Timeout in milliseconds without any stream events before cancelling and failing over.

forge.failoverBudgetMs.description: Total failover time budget in milliseconds across all retries and model switches.

forge.contextBudget.description: Token budget (~4 chars/token) for automatically assembled context.

forge.fallbackContextBudget.description: Token budget (~4 chars/token) for context when using the fallback agent.

forge.explorationBudget.description: Exploration budget: maximum read-only tool calls (read_file, search_workspace, list_dir) allowed per run.

forge.faultInjection.description: Simulate primary provider failures to verify automatic fallback without breaking API keys.

forge.guide.character3d.description: Show a procedural 3D Forge character beside the Ask Forge strip (falls back to 2D SVG avatar if WebGL is unavailable or slow).

forge.panel.theme.description: Panel color theme override: 'auto' follows VS Code, 'light' forces White theme, 'dark' forces Black theme.
